title: Not sore = no gains? WRONG 🙅
caption: Soreness peaks one to three days after a new workout and fades as your muscle adapts, but growth keeps going. Track your lifts, not your pain. Do you feel guilty when you're not sore? 👇
first_comment: Be honest: do you judge a workout by how sore you are the next day? 🤕
sources: Schoenfeld BJ, Contreras B. Is postexercise muscle soreness a valid indicator of muscular adaptations? Strength Cond J 2013;35(5):16-21
DOMS peaks 24-72 h, repeated bout effect: Nosaka 2008; Cheung et al. Sports Med 2003; McHugh 1999
